title: Bloo... Me? No.
html_source:
Bloom mistakenly believes that a pamphlet might be about him, ‘Bloom’, but it instead turns out to be about ‘Blood of the Lamb’. It’s reflective of the way in which Bloom is viewed as wounded victim, compassionate, sympathetic and cuckolded.

It’s derived, of course, from the Bible, specifically the Book of Revelations: http://biblehub.com/revelation/12-11.htm
